scenes.title: One order. Governed at every step.
scenes.banner: One order / separate identities / trusted boundary / accountable people
scenes.industryContextLabel: Turkish industry context. No affiliation implied.
scenes.takeaway: ONE SUPERVISOR. FIVE SPECIALISTS. A TRUSTED POLICY BOUNDARY.

beats.text: This proposal uses AI-powered agents. The Orchestration Agent dispatches work to five specialists. A trusted boundary controls every state change.
The goal stays simple: less rework, faster activation, and clear customer status.

scenes.title: Accept once. Keep the handoff.
scenes.ownerLabel: ORDER INTAKE / ATOMIC SAVE AND REPLAY CHECKS
scenes.takeaway: SAVE THE ORDER AND EVENT TOGETHER. DO NOT ACCEPT A DUPLICATE.

cards.title: CUSTOMER ORDER
cards.body:
Approved product.
Stable request key.

cards.title: ATOMIC SAVE
cards.body:
Order and event together.
No lost handoff.

cards.title: SAFE REPLAY
cards.body:
Resume saved work.
Reject changed replays.

exception.title: INVALID REQUEST
exception.body:
Return for correction.
Do not invent details.

beats.text: Intake saves the order and event together. A stable request key prevents duplicate acceptance.
Invalid requests return for correction. Accepted work resumes from its saved stage.

scenes.title: Catch errors before allocation.
scenes.ownerLabel: VALIDATION / FEASIBILITY ONLY, NO ACTIVATION AUTHORITY
scenes.takeaway: CHECK THE SITE AND CAPACITY. NEVER INVENT AN APPROVAL.

cards.title: RECEIVED ORDER
cards.body:
Relevant site facts.
Approved catalogue.

cards.title: VALIDATE
cards.body:
Check references
and available capacity.

cards.title: FEASIBLE INTENT
cards.body:
Only validated work
moves to planning.

exception.title: STOP AND RESOLVE
exception.body:
Customer corrects the site.
Manager reviews capacity.

beats.text: The Validation Agent checks the site and capacity. Early checks prevent downstream rework.
Wrong addresses need customer correction. Missing capacity needs resolution, not an invented approval.

scenes.title: Plan once. Keep every task linked.
scenes.takeaway: TM FORUM-INSPIRED CONTRACTS. LINKED WORK. NO REKEYING.

cards.title: PRODUCT ORDER
cards.body:
TMF622-inspired intake.
Approved catalogue.

cards.title: SERVICE ORDERS
cards.body:
TMF641-inspired services.
Linked to the product.

cards.title: RESOURCE ORDERS
cards.body:
Ports and IP blocks.
Same order identity.

beats.text: The Decomposition Agent creates linked service and resource orders using approved catalogue mappings.
TM Forum inspired contracts remove rekeying. Planning grants no permission to activate.

scenes.title: The boundary checks. Then commits.
scenes.ownerLabel: ONLY THE TRUSTED BOUNDARY COMMITS POLICY-VALIDATED CHANGES
scenes.takeaway: MODELS PROPOSE. POLICY ENFORCES. ALLOCATE ONCE.

cards.title: AGENT PROPOSAL
cards.body:
Approved plan and stage.
No arbitrary allocation.

cards.title: BOUNDARY CHECKS
cards.body:
Capacity, risk and window.
Identity and revision.

cards.title: ATOMIC COMMIT
cards.body:
Allocate only once.
Persist result and audit.

beats.text: The Provisioning Agent proposes activation. The boundary rechecks capacity, risk and the change window, then allocates once.
Timeouts wake the Fallout Recovery Agent. High-risk work waits for a human decision.

scenes.title: One known fault. One permitted retry.
scenes.ownerLabel: RECOVERY / ONE ALLOWLISTED PLAYBOOK, NO APPROVAL AUTHORITY
scenes.takeaway: ONE ALLOWLISTED RETRY. HAND BACK. NO UNRESTRICTED TOOLS.

cards.title: KNOWN TIMEOUT
cards.body:
Allowlisted fault only.
No general-purpose tools.

cards.title: RETRY ONCE
cards.body:
One approved playbook.
No endless loop.

cards.title: HAND BACK
cards.body:
Return to provisioning.
Never reserve twice.

beats.text: The Fallout Recovery Agent retries one allowlisted timeout, then hands control back to the Provisioning Agent.
Other faults go to the service desk. People own resolution; agents gain no broader authority.

scenes.title: A named person owns the decision.
scenes.ownerLabel: PERSONAL ENTRA SIGN-IN / SERVICE MANAGER ROLE / AUDITED DECISIONS
scenes.takeaway: MANAGER AUTHORITY IS NEVER SHARED WITH AGENTS OR PARTNERS.

cards.title: PERSONAL SIGN-IN
cards.body:
Own Microsoft Entra ID.
Named service manager.

cards.title: ROLE-CHECKED ACTION
cards.body:
Approve or reject risk.
Record who decided.

cards.title: NO BYPASS
cards.body:
Agents cannot approve.
Neither can partners.

beats.text: Each service manager signs in with their own Microsoft Entra account. The manager role controls high-risk decisions.
Agents and partners cannot approve. Decisions are audited; approval cannot create missing capacity.

scenes.title: Truthful status. Authorized access.
scenes.ownerLabel: BOUNDARY-ONLY EMAIL / CUSTOMER SIGN-IN AND ORDER OWNERSHIP
scenes.takeaway: ACTIVATE FIRST. CONFIRM SECOND. SHOW ONLY THE CUSTOMER'S ORDER.

cards.title: ACTIVATION RESULT
cards.body:
Verified service status.
No false success.

cards.title: BILINGUAL UPDATE
cards.body:
Turkish and English.
Boundary-controlled email.

cards.title: CUSTOMER SIGN-IN
cards.body:
Check order ownership.
No anonymous tracking.

beats.text: The Customer Updates Agent prepares Turkish and English confirmations. Only the boundary sends email.
Status links require customer sign-in and order ownership. Partner tools remain authenticated and organisation-scoped.

scenes.title: One identity. Only the permitted job.
scenes.ownerLabel: AZURE RBAC + RECEIVING-API ALLOWLISTS / DENY CROSS-ROLE ACCESS
scenes.takeaway: IDENTITY IS NOT UNLIMITED PERMISSION. ENFORCE THE LIMITS AT THE API.
events: Separate Entra agent and runtime identities
Exact role + caller + operation / reject excess authority

cards.title: ENTRA IDENTITIES
cards.body:
Separate hosted agent IDs
and runtime identities.

cards.title: LEAST PRIVILEGE
cards.body:
Only own project and tools.
No direct state access.

cards.title: API ENFORCEMENT
cards.body:
Token, caller and operation.
Model output is a proposal.

beats.text: Every agent has a separate Entra identity. Each runtime reaches only its own project and tools, with no direct state access.
APIs verify the token, caller and permitted operation. Model output is a proposal, never permission to bypass policy.

scenes.title: Protect the data. Keep it local.
scenes.ownerLabel: TURKIYE RESIDENCY / PRIVATE STATE, LOCAL INFERENCE AND CONTROLLED EGRESS
events: Customer data and inference at an approved Turkish operator site
Local keys, logs and backups / reviewed metadata flows
scenes.takeaway: LOCAL CUSTOMER DATA AND INFERENCE. REVIEW EVERY OUTBOUND FLOW.

cards.title: DATA PROTECTION
cards.body:
HTTPS and private state.
Scoped identity access.

cards.title: AZURE LOCAL
cards.body:
Turkish operator site.
Local data and inference.

cards.title: CONTROLLED EGRESS
cards.body:
Local keys and backups.
Approve metadata flows.

beats.text: The proposed design protects state with private storage and scoped access. Customer data and inference stay in Turkey.
Azure Local hosts the workload with local keys, logs and backups. Every outbound metadata flow is reviewed.

scenes.title: Accountable people. Governed agents.
scenes.ownerLabel: AGENT 365 + ENTRA / GOVERNANCE, OVERSIGHT AND ENFORCED PERMISSIONS
events: Every agent has a named business sponsor and technical owner
Agent 365 governance / inventory, oversight and access reviews
scenes.takeaway: SPONSOR: PURPOSE, RISK, BUDGET. TECHNICAL OWNER: RELEASES AND INCIDENTS.

cards.title: BUSINESS SPONSOR
cards.body:
Approve purpose, risk
and budget.

cards.title: TECHNICAL OWNER
cards.body:
Test releases and monitor.
Own incidents and rollback.

cards.title: AGENT 365 GOVERNANCE
cards.body:
Inventory and oversight.
Policies and access reviews.

beats.text: Every agent has a named business sponsor and technical owner. The sponsor approves purpose, risk and budget; the owner controls releases and incidents.
Agent 365 is part of the governance solution, bringing inventory and oversight alongside audit trails, access reviews, alerts and identity revocation.

scenes.title: Faster progress. Controlled authority.
scenes.ownerLabel: CUSTOMER VALUE / FASTER PROGRESS WITH ACCOUNTABLE CONTROL
events: Early checks + durable handoffs + bounded recovery
Named people + scoped identities + auditable decisions
scenes.takeaway: FASTER DELIVERY WITHOUT GIVING AGENTS MORE AUTHORITY THAN THEIR JOB.

cards.title: LESS REWORK
cards.body:
Validate early.
Keep tasks linked.

cards.title: SAFER PROGRESS
cards.body:
Bounded actions.
Human risk decisions.

cards.title: ACCOUNTABLE VALUE
cards.body:
Visible customer status.
Review outcomes and cost.

beats.text: Early validation, linked work and bounded recovery reduce avoidable waiting.
The objective: faster activation with visible status, named accountability, and no excess agent authority.
